mapper.sql: SELECT l.*, u.nickname AS user_name, d.name AS dept_name, v.voucher_no FROM fin_loan l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = l.dept_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = l.voucher_id
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.claim_no, v.voucher_no FROM fin_loan_repay r LEFT JOIN fin_expense_claim c ON c.id = r.claim_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = r.voucher_id WHERE r.loan_id = #{loanId} ORDER BY r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_loan SET repaid_amount = repaid_amount + #{amount}, status = CASE WHEN repaid_amount + #{amount} >= amount THEN 'CLEARED' ELSE 'PAID' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAID' AND repaid_amount + #{amount} <= amount
